title: Woman Wading Under Steel Bridge, 1955 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white square snapshot capturing a woman wading in the shallow waters of a riverbed. In the background, a large steel truss railroad trestle bridge spans across the water, mounted on sturdy concrete pillars. Several other people are visible enjoying the outdoors near the base of the bridge, while scenic hills line the horizon. The right margin features a small printed photo processing code ". 55", indicating a date around 1955.
